title: Document Retrieval Systems
summary: This module provides various strategies for retrieving relevant documents, ranging from abstract base classes to specialized implementations for query generation, document compression, and external search integrations.

nodes.label: Base Retriever
nodes.title: Base Retriever Interface
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all document retrieval systems, defining the core interface for fetching relevant documents based on a query. All concrete retrievers implement or extend this class.

nodes.label: Base Document Compressor
nodes.title: Base Document Compressor Interface
nodes.description: Abstract base class for components designed to refine or compress retrieved documents, often used as a post-processing step after initial retrieval.

nodes.label: Extract Relevant Content
nodes.title: LLM Chain Extractor
nodes.description: Uses an LLM chain to extract and compress relevant sections from documents, focusing on key information related to a given query.

nodes.label: Filter Documents by Relevance
nodes.title: LLM Chain Filter
nodes.description: Filters documents based on their relevance to a query, employing an LLM chain to determine which documents should be included or excluded from the results.

nodes.label: Rerank Documents with Cohere
nodes.title: Cohere Rerank Compressor
nodes.description: Reranks retrieved documents using the Cohere Rerank API, enhancing the relevance of search results by scoring documents against the query.

nodes.label: Combine Multiple Retrievers
nodes.title: Ensemble Retriever
nodes.description: Combines results from multiple underlying retrievers using a rank fusion algorithm to produce a more comprehensive and robust set of relevant documents.

nodes.label: Generate & Retrieve with Multiple Queries
nodes.title: Multi-Query Retriever
nodes.description: Generates multiple diverse queries from a single input using an LLM, then retrieves and combines documents from all generated queries to broaden search coverage.

nodes.label: Retrieve Parent Documents from Chunks
nodes.title: Multi-Vector Retriever
nodes.description: Retrieves full parent documents by performing similarity searches over smaller, embedded child chunks, ensuring that complete document context is returned for relevant sections.

nodes.label: Generate Structured Queries for Vector Store
nodes.title: Self-Query Retriever
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to parse a natural language query into a structured query, which is then executed against a vector store for more precise and filtered document retrieval.

nodes.label: Search Web with Exa
nodes.title: Exa Search Retriever
nodes.description: Integrates with the Exa Search API to perform targeted web searches and retrieve relevant documents directly from the internet, enhancing real-time information access.

nodes.label: Search Web with Perplexity
nodes.title: Perplexity Search Retriever
nodes.description: Integrates with the Perplexity Search API to perform web searches and retrieve relevant documents, leveraging Perplexity's search capabilities for comprehensive results.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: A large language model used for various tasks such as generating queries, filtering documents, or extracting information.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Prompt Template Definition
nodes.description: Defines the structure and content for prompts that are sent to language models, guiding their output for specific tasks.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: Vector Embedding Database
nodes.description: A database optimized for storing and querying vector embeddings, enabling efficient similarity search for documents or document chunks.

nodes.label: External Search API
nodes.title: Third-Party Search Service
nodes.description: Represents external web search services (e.g., Exa, Perplexity) used to fetch real-time or indexed information from the internet.

groups.label: Core Abstraction
groups.title: Core Retriever Interface
groups.description: Defines the fundamental interface and behavior for all document retrieval components.

groups.label: Document Post-processing
groups.title: Document Compression and Filtering
groups.description: Components responsible for refining, compressing, or filtering documents after initial retrieval to enhance relevance or reduce verbosity.

groups.label: Query Transformation
groups.title: Advanced Query Generation
groups.description: Retrievers that leverage Language Models to transform or generate queries, enabling more sophisticated and targeted document searches.

groups.label: Retrieval Orchestration
groups.title: Combining Retrieval Strategies
groups.description: Components that combine or manage multiple retrieval mechanisms to achieve more robust or context-aware document fetching.

groups.label: External Search Integrations
groups.title: Web Search and External Data
groups.description: Retrievers designed to integrate with and fetch information from external web search APIs and services.
